newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Commerical restructure plan approved.
newsitem.headline: Asia Commerical restructure plan approved.

text.p: Asia Commmercial Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its proposed capital and debt restructuring plan has been approved by shareholders, its bankers and holders of its Swiss Franc Convertible Notes due 2000.

Pacific Apex International Ltd, Leung Chung-Ping and Galmare Investment Ltd had agreed to subscribe for a total of 112.5 million shares of HK$1.0 each, representing about 40.2 percent of the restructured share capital of the company, to give effect to the plan, it said in a statement.
All of the resolutions relating to the proposed plan were approved by shareholders at the special general meeting held on December 23 and by note holders in a meeting on December 20.
Dealing in Asia Commercial shares has been suspended since May 20, 1996, pending an announcement.

The company posted a HK$94.48 million loss for the six months ended September, 1996, since it had been operating under very difficult condition due to a shortage of working capital and was dependent on the support of its creditors and banks, it said earlier.
Asia Commercial is a maker of watch parts and floppy disk drives.
